Medium close-up on a 50mm lens at eye level, composed for 16:9. Scarlett (Image 1) stands beside a low concrete parapet, holding the opened lipstick from (CORAL_LIPSTICK) near her mouth while a phone in the other hand is angled as a dark reflective mirror, poised just before a quick touch-up. Potted grasses occupy the lower foreground, with a rooftop ledge, pale sky, reflective glass towers, and a distant elevated train behind. Wind presses through the exposed rooftop and shifts loose strands as Scarlett (Image 1) focuses on the phone reflection, weight subtly forward. Warm directional late-afternoon sunlight rims the subject and concrete, with airy sky fill. Clean, bright, tactile modern social-first beauty editorial photography.
